items.title: COACH NAMES 35-MAN SQUAD AGAINST SOMALIA, GHANA IN AFCON QUALIFIERS
items.summary: Coach Johnathan McKinstry has announced a preliminary 35-man squad for Gambia’s upcoming 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers, against Somalia and Ghana. The Scorpions will first play Somalia at home on September 25 and then play away in Ghana against The Black Stars, on the ...
